output:
I'll start by discovering the inventory MCP tools.

Let me start with the adjustments list and the west query.

The query returned a 503, so I'll retry it. I'll also page through the adjustments.

All three transfers (HX-1003, HX-1006, HX-1013) are missing their west side. I'll record those now.

Two calls failed. The 504 may still have been applied, so I'll check the adjustment records before retrying.

The HX-1003 timeout did apply (adj-327), so I won't resend it. HX-1006 did not apply, so I'll retry that one.

Now I'll read the west list again, page by page.

Only HX-1006 is discontinued, because it drops out of the non-discontinued list. That leaves 18 candidates, so I'll fetch per-warehouse stock for each.

I've worked out the moves. I'll apply them in batches and reconcile each batch against the adjustment log, since calls can fail or time out and still apply.

Every call succeeded, and the adjustment ids run contiguously from adj-330 to adj-370. Now I'll write the output files.

The west refill is done. All 18 qualifying items were refilled as far as `north` and `east` allowed, and seven of them still fell short. I wrote `/app/shortfall.csv` and `/app/STATUS.json` (status `success`). I confirmed the 18 qualifying items from item and stock reads, but I did not re-query stock after the moves.

- **Missing west sides:** The 06:00 job had taken stock out of `north` for HX-1003 (10), HX-1006 (10) and HX-1013 (4) without adding it to `west`. I added those quantities to `west` with the same references. The first HX-1003 call timed out but had been applied, so I checked the log and did not resend it.
- **Refills:** HX-1006 is discontinued, so it got no further refill. The other 18 items were below their reorder point with the right category. Each move is a source take-out plus a matching `west` add, all with reason `transfer` and reference `RP-0914-<sku>`. All of those calls succeeded.
- **Source limits:** No source warehouse went below the item's `reorder_point`.
- **Shortfalls:** `north` and `east` together couldn't cover these seven items, so I moved what they had:

| sku | missing |
|---|---|
| HX-1009 | 68 |
| HX-1022 | 59 |
| HX-1023 | 18 |
| HX-1030 | 33 |
| HX-1035 | 16 |
| HX-1039 | 4 |
| HX-1050 | 7 |

The service logged all adjustments dated 2026-09-14, while the runtime date is 2026-10-19. I treated the 2026-09-14 06:00 `RP-0914-*` transfers as "today's" job, since they were the only unfinished ones.
